decision.title: CI is disabled for now; gates are checked locally
decision.summary: CI is disabled for now: gate boxes that name CI are satisfied by the same checks run locally, and macOS, Windows and MSVC stay unverified as a known risk.

body.p: at the owner's word ("CI is disabled, we don't need it at this point"). Gate boxes that name CI are satisfied by the same checks run locally (all presets, lint, slice, conformance runs, fuzzing). macOS, Windows and MSVC stay unverified until CI returns; that remains a known risk.
